ud7.2:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthī, in Jeta’s Wood, at Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
ud7.2:1.3: Then at that time venerable Sāriputta, thinking that venerable Bhaddiya the dwarf was still a trainee,
ud7.2:2.1: o was instructing, rousing, enthusing, and cheering him in abundant and countless ways with a Dhamma talk. The Fortunate One saw venerable Sāriputta, (who was) thinking that venerable Bhaddiya the dwarf was still a trainee, o instructing, rousing, enthusing, and cheering him in abundant and countless ways with a Dhamma talk.
ud7.2:3.1: Then the Fortunate One, having understood the significance of it, on that occasion uttered this exalted utterance:
ud7.2:4.1: “He has cut off the cycle, gone to the desireless,
ud7.2:4.2: Dried up, the stream no longer flows,
ud7.2:4.3: Cut off, the cycle no longer rolls on,
ud7.2:4.4: Just this is the end of suffering.”
